dec.n: IHRDA (on behalf of Sierra Leonean refugees) v. Guinea
dec.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: After Guinea’s president said in a radio speech that refugees should be sent home, soldiers and civilians attacked Sierra Leonean refugees. The African Commission held Guinea responsible.
dec.pi: Setelah presiden Guinea mengatakan di radio bahwa pengungsi harus dipulangkan, tentara dan warga menyerang pengungsi Sierra Leone. Komisi Afrika menyatakan Guinea bertanggung jawab.
